sourceSetup.nfsSetupDetails: Usa un recurso compartido NFSv3 sobre TCP. Si se exige cifrado, tanto el servicio NFS como el de montaje deben admitir RPC-with-TLS. Deja el certificado personalizado en blanco para usar un certificado de servidor de confianza para este dispositivo, o añade el certificado de CA o autofirmado del NAS. El nombre del certificado debe coincidir con el host del punto de conexión. Si el NAS exige TLS mutuo, añade su identidad de cliente PKCS#12. Por último, confirma que el recurso compartido permite los UID/GID de AUTH_SYS configurados y la política de puertos del cliente.

games.helpBody:
Enable Games for your profile, choose a computer and approve the first connection. Sunshine-compatible hosts load their app list into the game grid. On Android, Steam pairing opens Big Picture inside PlezyNG; saved Steam app-ID shortcuts launch directly. Steam pairing does not grant access to a private account library.

Both Android engines include touch controls and gamepad input. Pyrowave is an experimental Android option; other native platforms remain in development.

Pairing requires the host’s approval. Sunshine QR codes open its PIN page without carrying credentials. For access away from home, use the computer’s VPN address. Automatic discovery normally stays on the local network.

Disconnecting leaves the game running on the computer.
games.manualHint: For Moonlight use the host’s GameStream HTTP port (usually 47989), not its web settings port. Steam normally advertises on 27036.
games.engineUnavailable: In-app streaming is not available here yet
games.nativeEnginePending: This build does not include a streaming engine for this platform. You can save the computer, but it cannot play here yet.
games.steamEnginePending: This build does not include the embedded Steam engine. Android builds with Games enabled bundle device pairing and in-app H.264/HEVC playback. Pyrowave is experimental on Android; other platforms remain under development.
games.steamBetaDescription: Experimental Steam beta codec. Off by default; it uses 5–10× more bandwidth than H.264/HEVC, and Valve recommends gigabit Ethernet. Android playback is limited to SDR 4:2:0 with CPU readback and has not been device-qualified.
games.steamPairInstructions: Enter this code in Steam’s Remote Play pairing prompt on your computer. Keep this screen open until Steam approves.
games.steamLibraryHint: Steam device pairing opens its library inside the stream. Add a shortcut with a Steam app ID for direct launch. Importing a private account library as game cards requires a separate authenticated catalog connection.
